slides.heading: Maximize Expression
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Dynamic Programming
slides.narration: Let's solve Maximize Expression, a hard dynamic programming problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Max of a - b + c - d over indices a < b < c < d (0 if fewer than 4 elements).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Max of a - b plus c - d over indices a under b under c under d (0 if fewer than 4 elements). Four rolling DP layers.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Build the expression one term at a time: best a, then best a minus b, and so on, each over a prefix.
slides.narration: Build the expression one term at a time: best a, then best a minus b, and so on, each over a prefix.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 2. Each layer uses the previous layer up to the index before
slides.narration: Step by step. First, four arrays of running bests. Second, each layer uses the previous layer up to the index before. Third, return the last layer's max.
